extracted.name: How to Basic: Marry Me Chicken Pasta
extracted.description: How to Basic marry me chicken pasta: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iq-YdZk7Q0c This is the version I usually follow although sometimes I do not follow the recipe exactly
instruction_lines: Boil water and cook penne pasta for 10 minutes until soft.
Dice chicken breasts, season with salt and pepper, and mix well.
Heat olive oil in a pan, adicionar chicken, and cook for 8 minutes until done. Set aside.
Melt butter in the pan, adicionar garlic, and cook until fragrant.
Adicionar flour to make a paste, then whisk in chicken stock, heavy cream, and parmesan cheese.
Stir in sundried tomatoes, Italian herbs, and paprika. Simmer for 5 minutes to thicken.
Adicionar cooked chicken and pasta to the sauce. Mix thoroughly.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve.
